text:
samir: Incident detected in EU region — elevated kvcache errors and retry storms. Putting all non-critical release slots on hold. anyone oncall?

deploybot: deploybot: /hold release v1.14.0 — reason: incident_eu_kvcache. Canary and scheduled slots paused.

eli-oncall: eli-oncall: Confirmed alert surge at 23:08 UTC, error-rate ~1.8%. Will keep hold for now. jules-ops, can you look at failover traces?

jules-ops: jules-ops: On it. Looks like two replicas failed to complete failover; KV lookups are thrashing on fallback. I'm queuing a kube hotfix to reduce retry jitter.

ana-product: ana-product: Does this affect the beta rollout? we should prep a short note for status and release notes.

maria-eng: maria-eng: For in-flight releases — propose pinning the release manifest to v1.13.x stable and rescheduling v1.14.0 to the next change window (Thu 02:00 UTC). Any objections?

samir: samir: +1 to pin. Also want explicit rollback steps in the release notes: rollback path -> v1.13.7 if canary degrades. Need engineering + ops signoff before reschedule.

jules-ops: jules-ops: Rollback tested in staging earlier today. Example command and guard: `deploybot rollback --from v1.14.0 --to v1.13.7 --require-db-guard`. DB migration guard required.

deploybot: deploybot: Hold set by @samir. Canary jobs paused. To resume manually: `/deploy resume --id=release:v1.14.0 --confirm-by=ops` after signoff. Notifications posted to release owners.

ana-product: ana-product: I'll update release notes and changelog to reflect the delay and pin. Will draft status blurb for #announcements once we lock the new window.

eli-oncall: eli-oncall: Ops will monitor for 45m then re-evaluate. If error-rate < 0.3% and APDEX stable we'll consider unblocking.

maria-eng: maria-eng: Opening a small PR to pin versions in the release manifest and add rollback steps to the runbook. Link: https://git.redwood/release/PR-432

samir: samir: Action items — (1) ops monitor + confirm rollback readiness, (2) eng PR to pin + runbook, (3) product updates + status page, (4) schedule new window. Re-eval in 45m.

deploybot: deploybot: Automated notifications sent to release owners and oncall. React with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
